written: 2026-08-31, BEFORE the census run and BEFORE the whole-game differential run
question: Does the King's Rock flinch die fire per LANDED arrival, per DRAWN hit, or once per click?
what_was_landed: WIRE 103 now takes one die per LANDED arrival (R.arrivals, the same number -hitcount and timesAttacked read) instead of one per click. Knob MEDI_KINGSROCK_ONCE_PER_MOVE=1 restores the old behaviour and is registered in tests/test-mechanics.js DELIBERATE_BREAK.

which_scoreboard_should_move.the_lab: MOVES. One new census row (the volley count) and a new differential probe. This is where the fix is visible.
which_scoreboard_should_move.the_pinned_pool: PREDICTED UNMOVED, and the arithmetic is stated before the run rather than after it. 36 of 7,772 distinct teams in data/team-pool-frozen carry a King's Rock body with a multi-arrival move (0.46%); 52 of 13,214 bo3 games and 17 of 4,167 ots games contain one. A 961-game sample therefore expects ~4 such games, in each of which the body must additionally be BROUGHT, must CLICK the volley, and the extra dice must change a board leaf rather than a message. Expected movement 0. A move of +/-1 in either direction is luck, not signal, and is inside the band below.
which_scoreboard_should_move.damage_differential: NOT RUN. No damage byte moved; the change is one loop around a secondary die. Stated rather than quietly skipped.

predictions.why: exactly one new probe row is added (item/addsFlinch, the volley count). Nothing is removed and no existing probe reads a King's Rock volley, so no row can flip.
the new row is green on the live tree; it was shown RED first under the pre-fix engine and under the knob

see which_scoreboard_should_move. ~4 expected games carry the body at all; the extra dice can only matter if one of them lands a flinch the old engine did not, which is at most a 9-31 point probability difference on a turn that must also be reached.
same population. A flinch that fires in one engine and not the other writes a |cant| line, so protocol is the more sensitive of the two and is given the wider band.
no cause class is expected to be removed by this fix and none is expected to be created; the band carries the same luck as P4/P5.

a damaging click always runs _stepApply's tail, which is where R.arrivals is set. Non-zero means the fallback to one die was taken and the count is not trustworthy. NOTE: game_differential.js surfaces no MEDFAILS, so its POOL-SCALE reading is unknown by construction and is not claimed here.

declared_remainder_not_fixed.what: the die the authority takes on the arrival that KILLS
declared_remainder_not_fixed.why_not_fixed: this engine wraps the whole step list once per move, so the row is already fainted when WIRE 103 runs. Taking the die anyway would add a `sec` draw on every killing hit by a King's Rock holder, shifting the nth of later draws at the same address for zero board benefit.
declared_remainder_not_fixed.why_it_cannot_reach_a_board: the authority's own addVolatile bails on a body at zero (sim/pokemon.ts:1980), so the flinch it rolls for is refused there too
declared_remainder_not_fixed.counted_by: MEDSEEN.kingsRockRollSkippedOnKO, asserted >= 1 by the probe's kill arm and by the census row's fifth arm
